# Aeoden

> Aeoden is a free AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) tool that makes websites readable to AI. Enter a URL and it checks the files and signals AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity use, marks each Ready, Needs fix or Missing, and writes what's missing from the site's own content: llms.txt, Organization and WebSite structured data, robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, and an ai-catalog.json for sites that offer agent resources. It is a diagnostic, not a guarantee of rankings or citations.

## Key pages

- [Homepage and checker](https://aeoden.com/): enter a URL, get your AI files
- [Methodology](https://aeoden.com/methodology/): how each file is checked and generated, and every page check
- [What is AEO?](https://aeoden.com/what-is-aeo/): Answer Engine Optimization explained
- [AEO vs SEO](https://aeoden.com/aeo-vs-seo/): where the emphasis shifts
- [ChatGPT search readiness](https://aeoden.com/chatgpt-search/): which OpenAI crawlers matter and what gets quoted
- [What is llms.txt?](https://aeoden.com/llms-txt/): the convention, what it does and doesn't do

## Optional

- [Sources](https://aeoden.com/sources/): crawler documentation, standards and research behind the checks
- [About](https://aeoden.com/about/): who runs it, how the AeodenBot crawler behaves, contact
- [Privacy](https://aeoden.com/privacy/): what is sent, kept, and for how long
- [AI catalog](https://aeoden.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
